notes.title: 2025 Roadmap #1
notes.content: [p]🚨 Officers,[/p][p][/p][p]Our work on SWAT Commander continues! If you want to support it, remember that you can always take a look at [b]our special soundtrack bundle[/b] and currently get the game for a steal![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58925/SWAT_Commander__Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]In other news, we're sending you some fresh intel in the form of [b]a roadmap for our nearest milestones.[/b] Check out our plans for new missions and mission customization:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/17586f3b8aef65b118e14e48b0b8acec8e7c9e49.png"][/img][i]SWAT Commander 2025 Roadmap #1[/i][/p][p][/p][p]And now for something completely different. I've always wanted to say this unironically — it's a feature, not a bug.[/p][p]Many of you have been wondering [b]if suspects shooting at you through doors is a correct game mechanic in SWAT Commander[/b], so we wanted to provide a mini-tutorial to explain it a little better.[/p][p]Basically, violent [b]suspects in SWAT Commander can take a shot at you through a closed door even if they don't see you[/b]. Since they can hear you, this sort of incident can happen if you don't follow protocol and [b]move noisily around right behind the door[/b]. To prevent this, [b]equip your Tactical Mirror[/b], which puts you into a more stealthy mode and [b]try to stay by the sides of door frames[/b] whenever you can.[/p][p]The [b]upcoming Game Customization update[/b] that you can see in the roadmap above is going to include [b]an option to turn off the door shot mechanic completely. [/b]Based on your feedback, [b]we can also consider tweaking this mechanic further to improve your experience[/b].[/p][p]What's more, playing SWAT Commander on the [b]'Easy' difficulty level[/b] already [b]disables this mechanic[/b] in the current game version![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OY6L6wD71o4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Also, as always, thanks your feedback and keep it coming! Are there any features 'you' would like to see addressed in our updates? Stand by for more updates![/p][p][/p][p]Over and out,[/p][p]SWAT Commander Team[/p]

notes.title: SWAT Commander: Prologue v.0.7.7.5 — Features & Fixes
notes.content: [p]🚨 Officers,[/p][p][/p][p]We're updating SWAT Commander's co-op prologue to [b]version 0.7.7.5![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The update features a number of fixes and improvements that are [b]already available in the Early Access version of the game[/b], including the headcam mode that lets you play the game in a special, realistic view through your offcers' helmet-mounted cameras.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619310/SWAT_Commander/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Remember that the [b]Early Access version is already available[/b] and you can enjoy SWAT Commander there both [b]in single player 'and' co-op[/b], along with [b]five more missions[/b], plus additional ones that [b]will be added to it in the course of the game's development![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Early Access version also receives a new Advanced Game Modes update and a 20% discount right now![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144295/a4fd18172f1faf45fe2363873fe24ca6bfb5d85c.png"][/img][i]Remember that you can find the Headcam view that lets you observe the game from the SWAT officer's helmet-mounted camera in the gameplay settings[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]SWAT Commander: Prologue v.0.7.7.5 - Patch Notes:[/b][/p][p][b]AI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted reaction time of suspects and their decision to start shooting depending on the difficulty level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with the suspect's shield behavior during combat[/p][/*][/list][p][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added head camera view mode. Disabled by default, it can be enabled using the Y key, or via the gameplay settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the mission would not complete correctly if you scored only 0 points on 'Easy' difficulty[/p][/*][/list][p][b]EQUIPMENT[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added impact effect for all surfaces when using the battering ram[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional animations of weapon movement towards and away from the player when walking[/p][/*][*][p]Added randomization of attachments when using the randomize current equipment button on the equipment screen[/p][/*][/list][p][b]TUTORIAL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issues with the display order of tutorial stages.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added ability to bind scroll wheel to inputs contained in the menu tab[/p][/*][*][p]Added gamepad support for HUD chat, updated gamepad input[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the player names setting in the pause menu not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with input settings not initializing correctly on clients[/p][/*][/list][p][b]VFX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated effects of bullets hitting unprotected parts of the body[/p][/*][*][p]Updated bullet flight effect and tracer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with injury effects not spawning on some character models[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Follow our[/b] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619310/SWAT_Commander/"][b]SWAT Commander[/b][/url][b] app for future updates and development![/b][/p][p]Check out this video to see a preview of our Early Access "Game Modes" update today:[/p][previewyoutube="ajKK5dnQzV8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Stand by for more updates in our game's Early Access version, including [b]a new mission![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Over and out,[/p][p]SWAT Commander Team[/p]

notes.title: For Everyone who like FREE Games !
notes.content:
[p] BIG ANNOUNCEMENT! 

Greetings Commanders! 

First, a quick update on SWAT Commander: We're deep in development and working hard to bring you some fresh updates soon. Thank you for being such an awesome community!

Now for a surprise... While the next SWAT mission is being prepped, we invite you to take a break and try something new from our studio. The FREE playtest for our next game, Laundering Simulator, is LIVE NOW!

 What is Laundering Simulator? 
It’s a fun, relaxing sim where you run a laundromat as a front for a criminal enterprise. Manage crazy customers, dodge the FBI, and build your fortune—one clean shirt at a time.

 WIN A FREE COPY OF THE GAME! 

To make things more interesting, we're holding the First Laundering Contest!
Find a secret area in the playtest to get a special code. Post the code here in the #laundering-contest channel for a chance to be one of 10 WINNERS to get the full game for free on release!

Ready to get your hands dirty (by getting things clean)?

 Click Here to Join the FREE Playtest NOW! 
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432750/Laundering_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]

The playtest is only for a limited time, so don't miss out. We can't wait to hear what you think![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144295/699693e664f4088633db3b1302b5380c68fd7ca2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Continues!
notes.content: [p]Attention, Officers! 👮[/p][p][/p][p][b]Early Access[/b][/p][p]Thank you so much to you all joining [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619310/SWAT_Commander/"]SWAT Commander's Early Access release[/url] so far! With the [b]very positive rating reception[/b], we hope to see more and more of you report for duty, and we're very excited to find out how everyone liked our game![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619310/SWAT_Commander/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Share Your Creations![/b][/p][p]If you haven't yet, [url="https://discord.gg/DQepwC6CcN"]join our official Discord server![/url] We've just updated it with a new #creators channel, where you can post all SWAT-Commander-related content that you've created! Want to share a YouTube video about SWAT Commander or announce a scheduled livestream featuring our game? There's now a space for it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/50409b226e0a304b749c6d3d1ae3732b3e8ad759.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Requesting Feedback[/b][/p][p]As we always mention with every chance we get, we can't get enough feedback, as it's our key step to improving SWAT Commander further and further. Many enhancements to the game that you see today may have very well slipped through the cracks if it hadn't been for our community's will to share what they're thinking.[/p][p]At the same time, we want to respect your privacy, so if you don't feel comfortable posting any details regarding your hardware specs, your experience with SWAT Commander, and the like out in public spaces, we strongly encourage you to contact us privately through our official support email found here: [url="https://help.steampowered.com/en/wizard/HelpWithGameTechnicalIssue?appid=1619310"]https://help.steampowered.com/en/wizard/HelpWithGameTechnicalIssue?appid=1619310[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks and stay tuned for our Early Access plans![/b] We continue to make this game together with you, so your thoughts and opinions will greatly weigh in on those plans! [/p][p]Stand by for further game updates, our upcoming soundtrack, and next plans for Early Access! In the meantime, check out the new co-op preview trailer that we've added to the Steam page:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hJvOV3vKbQA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Over and out,[/p][p]SWAT Commander Team[/p]

notes.title: SWAT Commander Is Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Officers, 👮‍♂️[/p][p]The time has finally come! We are proud to report that…[/p][h2][b]📣 SWAT Commander is now available in Early Access![/b][/h2][p][b]This launch wouldn’t be possible without our fantastic community[/b], so we’d like to right away take this opportunity to [b]thank you all[/b] for the years of support and helpful ideas you’ve been sharing with us![/p][p]Leap into action and embark together with your squad on our [b]first six missions[/b], available in both [b]single and cooperative gameplay[/b] with [b]three different game modes[/b] each![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619310/SWAT_Commander/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]What’s currently available in Early Access?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Single player gameplay[/b] with a computer-controlled SWAT squad that takes orders from you as its leader.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dozens of direct and sequential commands [/b]that allow you to carry out your perfect strategies for breaching, entering, clearing, and securing targets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cooperative gameplay [/b]where you and your friends form a squad of your own with up to 5 players in total.[/p][/*][*][p][b]6 missions[/b] set in distinct environments, telling their participants about different situations that required a SWAT intervention.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 game modes [/b]for each of the missions that alter their environments and objectives into new challenges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Over 40 items of equipment[/b] – weapons with customizable attachments, helmets, armor, grenades, different ammo types, and special tools that you configure for yourself or your operatives.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A dedicated behavioral system[/b] that brings to life your officers as well as the civilians and suspects encountered during missions. With characters responding differently to various factors, your tactical skills will constantly be put to the test.[/p][/*][*][p][b]And many, many more features[/b] that will allow you to configure the challenge and experience you have with our game as well as possible.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visit [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619310/SWAT_Commander/"]our game's Steam page[/url][b] and check out our release date trailer for more![/b][/p][previewyoutube="mvsIEj8tyHs;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/DQepwC6CcN"][u]Discord[/u][/url] or let us know in our[url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1619310/discussions/"] [u]Community Discussions[/u][/url] if you have any feedback you’d like to share or questions you want to ask about our game![/p][p]Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team[/p]

notes.title: SWAT Commander: Prologue, version 0.7.7.0
notes.content: [p]Officers,  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]SWAT Commander is coming to Early Access on July 31st![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We continue gathering feedback and using it to find ways to improve the prologue for you. Our latest solutions bring you this patch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]AI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Suspects who previously surrendered and haven’t been restrained will return to combat when they see their accomplices arrive[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability of Suspects and Civilians to move away from doors when surrendering[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability of Suspects to perform a quick reload in the ‘fake surrendering’ mechanic if they need it[/p][/*][*][p]Updated system for NPCs choosing a position where they will surrender[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Suspects’ vision and hearing[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted weapon spread for shooting through doors[/p][/*][*][p]Updated shooting logic of Suspects – they will now save ammo if they can't see their target well[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted burst length for the ‘firing through objects’ mechanic – Suspects will now shoot through them with automatic fire[/p][/*][*][p]Improved focus system for Civilians (now they turn around more naturally)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Civilians would follow compliance orders from Officers even if they were far away or behind a wall[/p][/*][/list][p][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to check the status of the door without opening it (‘C’ key by default, also supported for gamepad)[/p][/*][*][p]Added game pause when gamepad is disconnected[/p][/*][*][p]Changed default game difficulty level to ‘Easy’[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced bleeding mechanic – you need to walk a greater distance before you take damage from blood loss[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced conditions for receiving Evidence/Suspect progression hints [/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the ‘firing through objects’ mechanic for Suspects when these conditions are met: no auto or burst fire mode is available for Suspects, ‘Easy’ difficulty level is enabled, the target door is metal, a mirroring Officer is behind the target door[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled window frame collision for grenades[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with various door interactions: e.g. deploying C2, wedging, working with locks, retrieving installed devices[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Sniper weapon firing issues (shooting, noise generation)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Sniper reporting previously reported NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Players will no longer receive a penalty for using lethal force against Suspects who are throwing a grenade[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with reporting of dead bodies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Officers transitioning from a leaning to a sprint state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed door lock and C2 interaction outlines on barricaded doors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player camera shake when tasing NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where progression hints would spawn too early if it took the game’s session a longer time to load for the host[/p][/*][/list][p][b]NETWORK[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated mission launching process – fixed the issue of repeated client reconnects when loading a mission if the host’s processing is slowed down by various factors, e.g. playing on HDD[/p][/*][*][p]Traffic optimization which should resolve many random disconnection issues[/p][/*][*][p]Added current ping display to UI (appearing for the client when ping is above 100 ms)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]EQUIPMENT[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the AC-60 rifle magazine mesh size to match its capacity[/p][/*][*][p]Updated idle animation for the PA-500[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with grenade flight smoothness[/p][/*][/list][p][b]CHARACTERS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed various visual issues with NPC meshes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]ANIMATIONS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated NPCs’ reaction animation while surrendering[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Door Wedge player interaction[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed interruption of NPCs’ fear animations while surrendering[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed C2 deployment animation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual issues in the process of restraining NPCs[/p][/*][/list][p][b]HOT RECEPTION LEVEL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed collisions & navigation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted shadow rendering so that they are cast at much greater distances[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Sniper FOV[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added secondary interaction for contexts when you have two options for interacting with various objects[/p][/*][*][p]Added 7 default loadout presets in the ‘Equipment’ screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added game mode sorting so that each mission has the same order of modes[/p][/*][*][p]Added more visible cues that mark Entrance selection and some other game settings as unavailable for session clients (some settings can only be changed by the session’s host)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Injector input so that now it’s split into two interactions – healing yourself and a target Officer[/p][/*][*][p]Changed name of the ‘Ping’ feature to ‘Mark Location’ and adjusted its localizations; the function remains the same where it’s used to mark a specific spot in the mission’s space for other players[/p][/*][*][p]Updated images: cover images for some missions and tutorial loading screen images[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the debriefing screen did not appear on clients[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the loading screen could reappear multiple times during the client loading process (noticeable in case of HDD use by host)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed gamepad-related issues in the UI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues that appeared while using multiple Pepper Sprays in the additional menu and other issues related to Pepper Spray display[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where progression hints would not appear if the host died[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed spectator camera issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with show/hide HUD setting[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing localization for Sniper position buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI display issues when removing C2[/p][/*][*][p]Removed tutorial screen at first launch[/p][/*][/list][p][b]AUDIO[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new TOC responses, e.g. Officer injury/death, start of mission dialogs, and more[/p][/*][*][p]added full voiceover to the Tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]added more SFX to the ‘Hot Reception’ level (environment, water, damaged lamps, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added attenuation to some equipment animations[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Battering Ram attenuation and sound cue[/p][/*][*][p]Updated bomb disarming dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]Updated weapon shot attenuation[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Suspect footstep attenuation[/p][/*][*][p]Updated explosion attenuation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with incorrect voices for various characters[/p][/*][/list][p][b]OTHER[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed damage-related achievements[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Major Update – SWAT Commander: Prologue, version 0.7.6.4
notes.content: [p]Officers,  [/p][p]We continue gathering feedback and using it to find ways to improve the prologue for you. Our latest solutions bring you this patch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]AI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed aiming for Suspects using the RPG launcher or the kamikaze behavior model[/p][/*][*][p]Civilians now react to nearby shooting when they have already surrendered[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Suspect/Civilian alert system[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the system of Suspects focusing on noise as well as fixed various character focus issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with Suspects’ fake surrender mechanic working less reliably than intended[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the ability of suspects and civilians to position themselves away from a door when surrendering[/p][/*][*][p]Suspects won't shoot if their target is not properly within line of sight[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the grenade throwing system of the AI to make it more consistent[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added bullet exit traces to surfaces they can penetrate[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Less Lethal Shotgun damage to be, in fact, less lethal[/p][/*][*][p]Updated noise system (it should now be easier to generate the necessary noise for various events at difficulty levels above Easy)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated C2 interaction area to make placing the charge easier and stop the lock and Tactical Mirror prompts from getting in the way[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed door ramming issues with the Battering Ram[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues related to carrying out and interrupting the restraining process[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed NPC head rotation bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the ‘Bring Order to Chaos’ objective, so that it is properly checked off[/p][/*][*][p]Updated bleeding system[/p][/*][*][p]Sniper's shooting is now improved with better mechanics and noise generation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed RPG missile damage[/p][/*][*][p]Sniper no longer reports previously reported individuals[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed penalties not being accounted correctly for characters with grenades[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed error caused by switching from leaning to sprinting in co-op[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]EQUIPMENT[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sight movement while Aiming Down Sights (ADS), affected by the Officer’s breathing, is significantly reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Increased speed of entering ADS[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced recoil for all handguns[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character model collision issue for taking damage when the character is using the Ballistic notes.title: Further Prologue Updates and Improvements
notes.content:
Officers, 

We continue our work on improving the prologue. All of it is based on the invaluable feedback with which you've been providing us and of course our drive to improve your experience with our preview of the game. So, today we're rolling out another update, this one for version 0.7.5.13, patch 0.4. 

Here's a brief reminder of the recent changes to the prologue:

[list]
[*]Updated difficulty levels: the Easy level now provides conditions better suited for getting to know the game's mechanics while the other levels were adjusted to improve the gameplay experience
[*]Updated Civilian behavior: Civilians are now more willing to comply with SWAT operatives' orders.
[*]Adjusted FXAA anti-aliasing to improve its visual presentation.
[*]Reconfigured the lobby system to focus on manually adding players via Steam friends list to improve the co-op experience.
[*]Fixed a stability issue reported to occur when Officers are in combat and when Suspects deploy grenades against you.
[*]Fixed the issue of grenade icons not appearing on screen for grenades thrown by Suspects.
[*]Based on your reports, we've resolved a number of matters that could cause the game to become unstable. Your general experience with the prologue's stability should now be improved.[/list]
Version 0.7.5.13, patch 0.4 changes:

[list]
[*]The Briefing screen has been revamped with more compacted sections for easier, more intuitive navigation. Many of our players have been, for example, skipping the option of selecting the entry point where you start the mission. We intend for this to make the Briefing features easier to access.
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed the camera to clip through walls and doors.
[*]Fixed an issue where some barricaded doors were in the wrong position for players who joined someone else's multiplayer lobby (clients).
[*]We've reworked a number of the game's features. They are now not impacted so much by the players' internet connection during co-op gameplay, which should result in general performance improvements in the game.[/list]
👉 [b]CRUCIAL NOTE: Please remember that the functioning of the multiplayer lobby depends on the host as well. Make sure you have a stable internet connection and your configuration meets the game's specs if you wish to host a game.[/b] 

Standby for further updates.

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: Updates / Thank You for Joining the Prologue’s Launch
notes.content:
Officers, 

We're creating SWAT Commander for you and we stand with you as our community, so following our prologue's launch, we'd like to first thank you all for joining to give the game a shot. We're excited to see that you are playing SWAT Commander, and we would also appreciate any constructive feedback from you if we can use it to improve the game. We are a small team with big ambitions, and we would like to make sure to bring you a title you will enjoy. Without you, it is impossible. 

Following that, we realize our co-op prologue hasn't met many of your expectations and we want to do what we can to address your concerns and further enhance your experience with SWAT Commander.

To that end, we've already updated the prologue. Based on your recent gameplay experience, we would like to give you the solutions:

- We've resolved an issue that caused some language versions of the game to be unavailable
- We've disabled the Quick Match feature in favor of making public lobbies simpler. Go to 'Browse Lobby' and join from there for a game with random players.
- Your lobby's roster is now locked once everyone selects the 'Ready' status; it re-opens only after the mission is over
- The team bar now features a permanent 'leave lobby' button to make exiting one easier

👉 [b]CRUCIAL NOTE: Please remember that the functioning of the multiplayer lobby depends on the host as well. Make sure you have a stable internet connection and your configuration meets the game's specs if you wish to host a game.[/b] 

Those are our updates for now. Much like in a SWAT intervention where something unexpected happens, you respond, you adapt, and then you persevere. We remain in the line of duty.

Over and NOT out,
SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: SWAT Commander!
notes.content:
[i]– Status report?
– The name of the game has changed.
– We're gonna need details.[/i]

Officers,

And details you shall receive. You're bound to have noticed that you're looking at a completely different game title in your announcements. Yes, "Tactical Squad: SWAT Stories" is now officially "SWAT Commander".

[b]Why and what does that involve?[/b]

The main reason why we're doing this is because we want to refresh our game's image and start operating under a more concise, recognizable name. All in an effort to have our game reach more players more easily. A sort of a fresh start if you will.
But are we expecting a new name to do the trick? Certainly not, after all the work and improvements that have been put into the game, we're bringing back more regular updates to let you know what we're planning – here on Steam, our Discord server, our X feed, perhaps even more?
In fact, we may soon just have some news for you around the corner that involve great opportunities for SWAT Commander!

[b]Is this a different game now? Are there new developers? Were you facing any problems?[/b]

None of the above, luckily! We're still working together as the exact same team on the exact same tactical team shooter simulating special police forces operations with both single player modes and co-op. Our previous name caused no problems for the game or the project's continuity. We all just strongly believe that this new title will be much more manageable and effective and telling the world what kind of game we want to bring it.

So, stay tuned for more updates. After all, it won't be much longer until you can play our game and, as mentioned above, we're going to have a lot to report on.

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team
